summary: Huachen AI Parking Management Technology Holding Co., Ltd furnished a Form 6-K on September 11, 2026, disclosing a September 9, 2026 press release announcing a strategic cooperation framework agreement with Hong Kong-based Beyinda Limited to expand sales of precision metal structural components in mainland China. The arrangement is non-exclusive, contains no minimum purchase, sales, pricing, commission or revenue-sharing commitments, and contemplates no consideration; commercial terms will be set only in future orders. Huachen contributes market channels and customer introductions; Beyinda handles manufacturing, quality and delivery. No board recommendation, advisor, premium or closing date is stated. Watch for conversion into firm orders and any related-party or governance issues.
